name: Pizzeria Alpenrose
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Alpenrose in Tux**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps! **Pizzeria Alpenrose** in **Tux** invites you to savor freshly baked pizzas, handmade pasta, and delicious Italian specialties—all with a cozy mountain touch. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a creamy **Carbonara**, our wood-fired pizzas are baked to perfection with the finest ingredients.

After your meal, warm up with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or a rich **Apfelstrudel**—perfect for sharing with friends or enjoying alone. The rustic ambiance and stunning views of the **Zillertal** Alps make every visit unforgettable.

Located just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Tux** is the ideal stop for food lovers exploring **Tirol**. Open year-round, **Pizzeria Alpenrose** welcomes you for lunch, dinner, or even a casual coffee break with homemade cakes.

Come taste the blend of Italian passion and **Tirol** hospitality—where every bite feels like a mountain adventure!
